heldout_bpb.method: exact enumeration of all 3^3 = 27 equally likely seed resamples
heldout_bpb.note: percentiles are over resamples whose mean curve crosses zero inside the tested range; with n = 3 the bootstrap distribution is coarse (at most 10 distinct seed multisets).
